title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with the System Settings edit permission could use the…
description: Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0 contain a vulnerability where users with System Settings edit permission can exploit the Automation Dependency Wheel REST API to write arbitrary files outside the intended directory. This improper restriction on uploaded automation dependency wheel filenames can lead to arbitrary code execution.
